questions.title: Retry policy for the importer: give up, or back off?
questions.context_md:
The importer retries a failed row immediately, three times, then drops it. On last night's run 412 rows failed the same way: the upstream API rate-limited us and every retry landed inside the same window.

```python
for attempt in range(3):
    r = client.post(url, json=row)
    if r.ok:
        break
    # no sleep - all three attempts land in the same rate-limit window
```

| Option | Rows recovered last night | Wall clock |
|---|---|---|
| A: exponential backoff, 5 tries | 412 of 412 | +9 min |
| B: drop and report | 0 of 412 | unchanged |

Both are one commit. A changes how long a nightly run takes; B changes what lands in the table.

options.label: Drop the row and report it

questions.pick_why: the failure is transient and the extra 9 minutes is off-hours
